description: Prerequisite tools and subscriptions of the managed workstation and its delivery lanes (Issue #89). Generic: no account, project key or credential value. Read by global/prerequisites.py for ./mhw check; check-only, nothing here is ever applied. Owner-specific values (active lanes, repositories, Sonar project keys) go in the untracked overlay/prerequisites.local.json.

lanes.workstation: use the agent harnesses under the managed configuration
lanes.delivery: this repository's PR, CI and release route
lanes.site: the site project: build, infrastructure, deploy
lanes.ci: provided by the CI runner, not needed on the workstation

items.name: Claude subscription (Claude Code CLI)
items.manual: Install Claude Code and sign in with the Claude subscription: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup

items.name: ChatGPT subscription (Codex CLI)
items.manual: Install the Codex CLI and sign in with the ChatGPT subscription: https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli

items.name: Kiro (CLI)
items.manual: Optional third harness; install from https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/

items.name: AWS account
items.manual: Site hosting; deploys run in the pipeline through OIDC, never from the workstation: https://aws.amazon.com/

items.name: Domain registration
items.manual: Keep the site domain registered and renewed with its registrar

items.name: iCloud+ custom-domain mail
items.manual: Optional contact inbox: https://support.apple.com/en-us/102540

items.name: Anthropic / OpenAI API keys
items.manual: Alternative access mode only (ADR-0003); never assumed, never stored here

items.name: GitHub account and CLI (gh)
items.manual: Install gh (https://cli.github.com/) and run gh auth login; merge-setting drift: global/github-repo-settings.sh --apply OWNER/REPO is the owner's act

items.name: SonarCloud
items.manual: Sign in at https://sonarcloud.io/ ; CI reads the SONAR_TOKEN secret, a local check reads it from the environment only if present

items.name: HCP Terraform (Terraform Cloud)
items.manual: Site state backend: https://app.terraform.io/ ; CI reads the TFC_API_TOKEN secret

items.name: Google Analytics 4
items.manual: Site usage and the funnel review: https://analytics.google.com/

items.name: LinkedIn and X accounts
items.manual: Publishing lane; posting stays a browser act

items.name: YouTube
items.manual: Optional video embeds

items.name: Dependabot
items.manual: Optional dependency hygiene, enabled per repository in its settings

items.name: Git
items.manual: Install Git: https://git-scm.com/downloads (on macOS it ships with the Xcode Command Line Tools)

items.name: jq
items.manual: Install jq: https://jqlang.org/download/

items.name: Python 3
items.manual: Python 3.9 or later; 3.11 or later for the Codex MCP rendering (ADR-0017): https://www.python.org/downloads/

items.name: Xcode Command Line Tools
items.manual: Run xcode-select --install

items.name: macOS Keychain (security)
items.manual: Part of macOS; credentials are read from it at launch (ADR-0017)

items.name: macOS admin account (managed settings)
items.manual: An administrator account: ./mhw install asks for its password once, for the system-wide protections

items.name: Terminal with bracketed paste
items.manual: Any current terminal enables it; the paste wrapper relies on it (ADR-0011)

items.name: Node.js with npm
items.manual: Node.js 22 with npm: https://nodejs.org/en/download

items.name: Terraform CLI
items.manual: Terraform 1.9 or later, for fmt, validate and plan only (apply is pipeline-only): https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/install

items.name: ESLint, TypeScript, Vitest, Playwright
items.manual: Project dependencies: npm ci in the site project

items.name: actionlint
items.manual: https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint

items.name: Checkov
items.manual: https://www.checkov.io/

items.name: shellcheck
items.manual: Preinstalled on the CI runner; locally: https://www.shellcheck.net/

items.name: bump-my-version
items.manual: Installed by the version workflow; locally not needed

items.name: PowerShell
items.manual: Windows installs use global/install.ps1: https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/install/installing-powershell

items.name: uv / uvx
items.manual: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/

items.name: Homebrew
items.manual: https://brew.sh/

items.name: chrome-devtools-mcp with Google Chrome
items.manual: Optional browser MCP; Google Chrome plus the MCP server rendered by ADR-0017

items.name: Docker or Podman
items.manual: Optional; the container mode is not built (#78)
